classes.summary: HpxShortcuts is a comprehensive Android UI automation flow class that provides extensive functionality for managing printer shortcuts. The class implements methods for creating, editing, deleting, and executing shortcuts with multiple destinations (print, email, save). Key features include: dynamic locator generation for parameterized elements (copies, color options, two-sided printing), toggle-based UI interactions for enabling/disabling destinations, confirmation dialog handling for destructive actions, form input methods for email configuration, color card selection by index, and shortcut execution with status tracking. The class follows a consistent pattern of wait-for-element operations with configurable timeouts and exception handling, making it robust for test automation scenarios. Notable patterns include the use of format specifiers for dynamic element identification, attribute checking for element states (enabled, selected), and swipe gestures for accessing off-screen elements.
